name: medikiosk-plus
description: MediKiosk+ — multilingual AI patient case-taking & OPD triage kiosk. Monorepo: frontend (React/Vite), backend (Express API), database (schema + migrations). Each package deploys independently.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix database
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
